verdict.rationale: The Trusted Agent Protocol is published openly. Its spec and README can be fetched without a key, it ships an open-licensed reference implementation, and it builds on the public RFC 9421 HTTP Message Signatures standard, so that layer can be read and implemented without signing anything. The Intelligent Commerce payment APIs (/acp/v1 tokens, instructions, credentials) are a different matter. They sit behind Visa's credential-gated gateway, sandbox access requires a sign-up with terms acceptance, and production requires contacting Visa. Missing for 10: explicit spec versioning or a changelog for TAP, an open spec for the core payment/credential protocol, and implementability of the payment flow without registration or agreement.
